context: Tests whether jooq-persistence writes a ProductRepository in the project's conventions: @Repository with a constructor-injected DSLContext, projections into Java records via Records.mapping (never fetchInto(Dto.class)), a category filter built from DSL.noCondition, paging with a matching count, the BR-001 in-stock condition marked with the qualified business rule comment, no @Transactional, no jOOQ types in the signatures, the Markers rows, the Handover, and the hand-off to the service skill. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Repository per aggregate
checklist.description: A ProductRepository class annotated @Repository in com.example.shop.persistence with the DSLContext injected through the constructor, matching CustomerRepository

checklist.name: Records.mapping into a Java record
checklist.description: The catalog query projects id, name, category, and price into a Java record (not named ...Record) with Records.mapping(X::new); fetchInto(SomeDto.class) is not used

checklist.name: BR-001 condition with marker
checklist.description: The query excludes products with in_stock = false in every case (with or without a category), and the comment '// UC-010 BR-001: ...' sits directly above that condition

checklist.name: Optional category filter
checklist.description: The category filter is optional and built type-safely (DSL.noCondition() or equivalent), with no SQL string concatenation

checklist.name: Paging and count
checklist.description: The list method takes offset and limit (or a page) with a stable orderBy on name, and a count method uses the same conditions

checklist.name: No jOOQ types leak
checklist.description: Public repository methods return records, lists, Optional, or primitives and take domain arguments, not Condition, Field, Result, or Record

checklist.name: No transactions in the repository
checklist.description: The repository carries no @Transactional and does not call ctx.transaction

checklist.name: Markers table updated
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md gains the Persistence rows of jooq-persistence (Code and Name); the All row stays, and no other file under docs/ is edited (new sections appended to docs/open-questions.md for a gap the agent found do not count as a change)

checklist.name: Handover and hand-off
checklist.description: The response contains a 'Handover from jooq-persistence (UC-010)' block with the method signatures and record types, and ends with 'Next: /spring-service UC-010'

checklist.name: Layer only
checklist.description: No service, controller, migration, or test class is created, and generated sources are not hand-written
